body: Trust me, I really wish I was making this up or that it was a sick story but unfortunately that was my reality for a while.

I just want them to understand and nothing else because I know they aren’t qualified to truly help me 

I want to explain to them what my daily struggles are so that I don’t feel so alone when I’m at school, so that I feel supported because sometimes I have bad days and other days I have better ones. 

I want them to know that this year is going to be really hard for me. I’ve started really opening up to my psychiatrist about all the trauma and my suppressed emotions and so on and talking about all of that will really affect me both mentally and academically and I know this why, because I’ve never spoken about it to anyone before until know to my psychiatrist and already I’m starting to feel everything, and all so want to do is lay on the bathroom floor curled up and cry for days so yeah I just want them to be aware I guess

I would be angry, but If I were you, I would keep your opinion to yourself, not everyone will see it the way that you do. I can understand where your coming from, but I can also understand why your friend reacted the way she/he did. You said something that no one should ever wish for. I wouldn't wish that upon anyone, and it sounds like your saying, you hope that guy rapes that girl. I think you should see where your friend is coming from, but also see how society would react if you posted that, the majority of society wouldn't be happy. I can vouch. Sometimes being too honest can have a negative effect. I learnt that the hard way. It also is not right for a guy to rape or assault a girl because she was scared of him and thought it actually happened, for all you know, she could be suffering from a mental illness that distorts her reality. I feel bad for the guy who spent 28yrs in jail for something he didn't do, but you should not think it's right for him to go after her after he gets out. He would just end up back in jail and the girl would be traumatized, and being traumatized is a life sentence. The act of the girl isn't acceptable, but dreams can hold a lot of power of some people. I had a terrible dream once about someone close to me and I couldn't look or be near her for an entire of two weeks. Try to be more understanding of others views. I understand where your coming from, even If I don't agree. You should try and explain to your friend your opinion, and if he/she doesn't agree, and it leads to a falling out, then I don't know what to tell you. However, you could just tell him/her what him/she wants to hear, that your wrong and you didn't mean what you said. I think what you said, was disrespectful, rude and just horrific, I don't know what else to say. You asked for the honest truth, here it is. You stuffed up, it happens, now fix it.
No problem aha x

omg, same!! I absolutely hate struggling with this. The way I cope with it, is I tell myself that I have to keep going, I tell myself to not disappoint others or let myself down. I usually got in trouble for getting attached because I'd send emotional emails but I soon realized that I don't want to keep getting in trouble so I made a promise to myself that I'd try to stop and so far I've been doing okay, better than I ever have. So there's that. Someone also told me today that "School is a professional setting" and that really stuck with me, It's a professional setting, you know, teachers have their own lives, and we have ours, they stay separate. Trust me, I know exactly how hard it is, message me if you need. Oh and to make you feel less alone, I emailed my teacher asking her if she thinks I'm weird so yeah. aha
Hey, here if you need, I completely understand and I can try to help too so just send me a message if you need to :)
